header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.arabic_text: كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أَحَدُنَا اَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ قَالَ: يُسَبِّحُ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ فَيُكْتَبُ لَهُ اَلْفُ حَسَنَةٍ وَتُحَطُّ عَنْهُ اَلْفُ خَطِيئَةٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب فضل التهليل والتسبيح والدعاء رقم:٦٨٥٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Sa'd (RA) says, “We were sitting in the gathering of the Prophet ﷺ. At that time the Prophet ﷺ asked, “Is any one of you able to earn a thousand good deeds every day?” One of those sitting in that gathering asked, “How can one of us earn a thousand good deeds?' ”If he recites Subhanallah a hundred times, a thousand good deeds are written for him and a thousand sins are forgiven,” the Prophet ﷺ replied.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِير ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ مِمَّا تَذْكُرُونَ مِنْ جَلَالِ اللهِ اَلتَّسْبِيحَ وَالتَّهْلِيلَ وَالتَّحْمِيدَ يَنْعَطِفْنَ حَوْلَ الْعَرْشِ لَهُنَّ دَوِيٌّ كَدَوِيِّ النَّحْلِ تُذَكِّرُ بِصَاحِبِهَا أَمَا يُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَّكُونَ لَهُ أَوْ لَا يَزَالُ لَهُ مَنْ يُذَكِّرُ بِهِ؟
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه باب فضل التسبيح رقم:٣٨٠٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “Among the words with which you speak of the greatness of Allah are the words Subhanallahi, wal-Hamdulillahi, wa La ilaha illallahu. These words keep circling on all four sides of the Arsh. Their sound is like the humming of bees. These Kalimahs mention the one who recites them in the court of Allah. Do you not like that someone should mention you in the court of Allah at all times?” Hazrat Nu'man ibn Bashir (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.
